name: Elevon
long_description:
Elevon is a multi-page Webflow template built for marketing and advertising agencies that need to present their services, case studies, and thought leadership in a commercially credible way. It is suited to agencies, consultancies, and growth-focused teams that want a polished web presence capable of attracting and converting new business leads.

The template spans 20 internal pages including a homepage, About, Services, Projects, and a contact page, along with four individual project detail pages, three CMS-powered blog post pages, and three product pages for Starter, Advanced, and Premium plans. Supporting pages include a style guide, changelog, licenses reference, and a custom 404. The homepage organises content across nine sections covering a hero with dual CTAs, a social proof bento grid, a company overview, performance metrics, a features or capabilities block, a pricing table, client testimonials, an FAQ accordion, and a blog preview strip.

The visual direction is bold and dark, built on a black base with purple accent colours used for CTAs, highlights, and chart elements. Typography is large and assertive in the hero and section headings, with body copy kept concise and purposeful. The bento-style card grid on the homepage surfaces a client testimonial with a portrait, a bar chart graphic, a client logo scroll, and a strategy statement in a structured layout that communicates credibility without relying on heavy imagery.

Customisation is supported by a CMS collection powering blog posts and project pages, a contact form, CSS Grid for the bento and layout sections, responsive navigation with a prominent contact CTA button, and a style guide page to streamline brand token updates. No ecommerce checkout is active despite product plan pages being present in the crawl.

name: Gelexa.
long_description:
Gelexa Studio is a multi-page Webflow template built for creative agencies and digital studios that offer brand identity, UI/UX design, development, and product design services. It gives studios a polished, conversion-focused web presence with clear service positioning, a project portfolio, and a contact pathway — all structured to attract high-growth brands and startups.

The template covers eleven internal pages including a home page, projects index, individual project case study pages, a services page, an about page, a blog, and a contact page. The home page leads with a full-viewport hero featuring a service bullet list, a rotating slider with project thumbnail previews, a studio introduction section citing 120-plus brand and startup clients, and a latest-projects grid. Project detail pages follow a consistent CMS-driven structure, and the blog and shop pages round out the content model.

Visually, the template uses a deep dark background with oversized bold typography — the studio name rendered at display scale — offset by small editorial image thumbnails and muted overlay tones. The layout communicates authority and craft without relying on bright accent colors. Interactions are active throughout, and the slider component adds motion to the hero without requiring background video.

On the Webflow capability side, the template is built with CMS collections powering project case studies and blog posts, making content updates straightforward without touching the Designer. It includes a contact form, a responsive navigation with a cart link indicating shop readiness, a hero slider, and interactions. The responsive design and web fonts are applied consistently across breakpoints, making the template ready to restyle and launch with minimal structural changes.

name: Reelva
long_description:
Reelva is a multi-page Webflow template built for video editing studios, post-production agencies, filmmakers, and content-driven creative brands. Its primary job is to help these businesses present their services, showcase client projects, and generate inquiries through a polished, professionally structured digital presence.

The template spans 26 internal pages covering a homepage, About, Services, Team, Pricing Plans, Projects portfolio, Blog, and Contact, alongside utility pages including a Style Guide, Changelog, Licenses, 404, and password-protected page. Service detail pages cover disciplines such as Post-Production, Color Grading, and Photo Retouching. Project detail pages and blog detail pages are CMS-driven, enabling scalable content management without rebuilding layouts. An ecommerce checkout flow with PayPal and order confirmation pages is also included in the page set.

The visual direction is built on a high-contrast black background with oversized white display typography, as seen in the hero headline treatment. Supporting imagery uses a stacked, tilted photo card motif. Section structure progresses from a cinematic hero through a values block highlighting Expertise, Integrity, and Partnership, a What We Do services overview, and a Portraits and Color Grading work showcase. A circular rotating call-to-action badge and a shopping cart icon in the navigation reinforce the studio-grade aesthetic. A responsive slider is used within the work sections.

Reelva is built with Webflow CMS collections powering projects, blog posts, services, and pricing plan content, making it straightforward to update and expand without touching layouts. A contact form is included for lead capture. The template features responsive design, responsive navigation with a multi-level pages dropdown, responsive slider, web fonts, symbols, a custom 404 page, and is retina ready.

name: Gelbero Wilson
long_description:
Gelbero Wilson Portfolio is a multi-page Webflow template built for independent designers, developers, and multidisciplinary creatives who need a polished online presence to present their work, communicate their services, and convert prospective clients. It is structured around a personal brand narrative, making it well suited for freelancers and consultants operating across brand identity, web design, and digital marketing disciplines.

The template covers a broad set of pages confirmed by the crawl: a home page with animated counters for completed projects, average ROI, and client satisfaction rate; a services page; an about page; a filterable project portfolio with individual case study pages grouped by categories such as branding and identity, product design, logo design, no-code development, and marketing strategy; a blog section with individual article pages and category filtering; a contact page; and utility pages including a custom 404, a password-protected page, and a style guide. CMS collections drive both the portfolio and blog sections.

The visual direction is defined by large-scale black display typography set against a light off-white background, creating strong contrast and editorial weight. The hero layout positions a circular portrait at center with service credentials flanking it and oversized name and location text anchoring the bottom of the viewport. Navigation is minimal and horizontal with a high-contrast contact button. Supporting sections include a selected works gallery, a client testimonials area, and an FAQ accordion.

On the Webflow capability side, the template uses CMS collections for projects and blog posts, a contact form, responsive navigation, a slider, and media lightbox. It includes social profile links for Instagram, Twitter/X, and LinkedIn, and spans 31 internal pages providing substantial out-of-the-box coverage for a freelance creative practice.

name: Suprix
long_description:
Fluxra is a multi-section Webflow template built for AI platform businesses and SaaS startups that need to communicate product value, showcase pricing tiers, and drive demo or trial sign-ups. It suits founders and growth teams launching intelligent workflow automation tools or AI-powered productivity platforms to a B2B audience.

The template spans 12 sections across a single-page layout with dedicated areas for hero messaging, an AI-powered feature set, benefits, transparent pricing at three monthly and annual price points, social proof with a trusted-by section, and a reviews block. Supporting pages include Privacy, Terms, 404, and License. Navigation links cover Home, Features, Benefits, Pricing, Reviews, and Get Started.

The visual direction pairs a warm off-white background with oversized black display typography and high-contrast orange call-to-action buttons, creating a bold editorial aesthetic with strong typographic hierarchy. The hero uses large-scale headline stacking with a photographic cutout element and a five-star social proof badge to establish credibility immediately. CTA pairings throughout the layout reinforce dual conversion paths, such as Book a Demo alongside Upgrade Your Plan.

Fluxra is built with CSS Grid for structured section layouts and includes a contact form for lead capture. Responsive navigation and web fonts are implemented throughout. The template does not use CMS collections, ecommerce, video backgrounds, sliders, or lightbox interactions, keeping the build lightweight and straightforward to customise in the Webflow Designer.

name: Suprix
long_description:
Suprix is a single-page Webflow template built for AI software companies, SaaS startups, and automation platforms looking to communicate their product value and convert visitors into leads or paying customers. It is designed around a clear commercial funnel — from a bold hero that frames the product promise to feature breakdowns, benefit highlights, pricing tiers, and social proof — making it a practical fit for early-stage AI tools or established platforms launching a new product line.

The template covers twelve sections across a single scrollable page, with a navigation bar linking to Home, Features, Benefits, Pricing, and Reviews anchors. Visible content areas include a hero with dual CTAs (Book a Demo and Upgrade Your Plan), a trusted-brands strip, an AI-powered features section with individual capability cards, a benefits section, a transparent pricing section displaying six plan tiers across two billing intervals, and a reviews section. Supporting pages for Privacy, Terms, 404, and License are also included.

The visual direction uses a vivid blue gradient hero anchored by large, heavy white typography, transitioning to a clean light-background layout for mid-page content. A product UI mockup displayed inside a device frame in the hero grounds the template in a real software context. The pricing section uses a straightforward card grid, and the overall tone is direct and commercially focused rather than decorative.

Customization is supported through CSS Grid layouts, a contact or demo request form, responsive navigation, and web fonts. The template does not use CMS collections, ecommerce, background video, sliders, or lightboxes. A custom 404 page is included. All layouts are fully responsive and retina ready.

name: Fluxra
long_description:
Fluxra is a multi-page Webflow template designed for creative studios, digital agencies, and marketing consultancies that need to present services, case studies, and thought leadership in a single cohesive site. It targets agency principals and freelancers who want a site that communicates strategic credibility while driving inbound inquiries from ambitious brands.

The template ships with 26 internal pages covering two homepage layouts, an About page, a Contact page, a Pricing page, two Project listing views, individual Project detail pages, individual Service detail pages, a Blog listing, three Blog post pages, a Style Guide, License, Changelog, Password, and 404 pages. Content is organised around services including Web Development, UI/UX Design, Brand Strategy, Marketing and Growth, 3D Render, and Product Design, with named portfolio case studies such as NEXA, OrbitFlow, Zenith Trade, Nova Connect, and Axion Grid providing evidence of real work scope.

Visually, Fluxra uses oversized display typography in heavy black weight against a warm off-white base, punctuated by a high-contrast orange accent on CTA buttons and iconographic arrows. A social-proof badge showing star ratings and a trusted-clients avatar stack appears above the fold. The hero layout offsets a dark editorial portrait photograph against the large typographic lockup, establishing an editorial, fashion-adjacent tension that differentiates it from generic agency templates. Numbered counters highlight credentials such as years of expertise and projects delivered.

Customisation is supported by a full Webflow CMS powering blog posts and project case studies, CSS Grid for structured layout sections, a responsive slider component, and a fully responsive navigation including a dropdown Menu item. The site includes a custom 404 page, web fonts, and retina-ready assets across all breakpoints.

name: Nexlify
long_description:
Nexlify is a multi-page Webflow template designed for SaaS products, workflow automation platforms, and operations-focused startups that need to communicate system complexity in plain, confident language. It is built for teams that need to move quickly from concept to a published marketing site without sacrificing structure or visual credibility.

The template spans 13 internal pages including Home, About, Products, Blog, Pricing, and a dedicated contact page. The blog is CMS-driven with at least three pre-built article pages covering workflow automation and systems topics. Supporting utility pages include a style guide, changelog, license page, instructions page, and a custom 404 error page, giving buyers a complete, launch-ready package.

The visual direction pairs a warm off-white background with high-contrast black typography and a restrained amber accent used for the logo mark and active navigation states. The hero section uses a split layout with a full-bleed editorial image, floating UI card overlays showing live session and goal completion states, and a scattered avatar composition that implies a collaborative user base. A horizontal logo marquee anchors the social proof zone below the hero fold. Section naming across the page — Workflow Management Simplified, Use Cases, World-Class Systems, Customer Testimonials, Product, FAQ, and Blog — maps to a complete SaaS conversion narrative.

Webflow-specific capabilities include a CMS collection powering the blog, CSS Grid used across section layouts, a responsive slider, responsive navigation with a mobile-ready structure, web fonts, retina-ready assets, symbols for repeating components, and a custom 404 page. Ecommerce, background video, lightbox, and interaction animations are not present in this template.

name: Calma
long_description:
Calma is a multi-page Webflow template built for life coaches, personal growth mentors, and wellness guides who need a professional web presence that communicates trust, calm, and credibility. It is designed to help practitioners present their story, define their offerings, and invite prospective clients to take the first step through a free consulting booking prompt.

The template covers eleven pages including About, Services, Blog, Contact, Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, Cookie Policy, a Style Guide, Licensing, Instructions, and a Change Log. Content sections visible across the site include a personal introduction with a coaching tagline, a My Story narrative block, a How I Help services grid covering growth support, community, emotional healing, and mindfulness, a testimonials section titled Words from the Heart, and a closing call-to-action section titled Start Your Healing Journey Today.

Calma uses a restrained, warm palette built on a soft cream background with deep forest-green typography and accents. Layout relies on CSS Grid for structured content alignment, while a slider component handles testimonial or multi-item presentation. The overall visual direction favors editorial stillness over animation, with generous white space, serif-influenced headings, and portrait-oriented imagery that centers the coach's personal presence.

The template includes a CMS collection that powers the blog, enabling coaches to publish and manage articles without touching the designer. Responsive navigation adapts the four-item menu for mobile viewports. A responsive slider handles rotating content blocks. Web fonts and retina-ready assets maintain typographic and visual quality across screen densities. No ecommerce, background video, or lightbox components are present.

name: Ordinis
long_description:
Ordinis is a multi-page Webflow template designed for professional services firms, management consultancies, and strategy agencies that need to communicate precision, accountability, and measurable outcomes to prospective clients. The template's copy and structure are built around a consultancy positioning — systematic execution, defined deliverables, and traceable results — making it immediately usable for businesses in consulting, marketing strategy, or operational transformation.

The template spans 21 internal pages covering the full client journey: a home page with a stat-driven hero, an About section, a Services overview with three dedicated service detail pages (Strategic Transformation, Growth Performance, Enterprise UX), five individual case study pages (Velocity, Stargos, Synergist, Fractional, Resonance), a case study index, a Team page, a Blog with at least one live post, a Pricing page, a Contact page, and utility pages including a style guide, changelog, GSAP instructions, and a custom 404 page.

Visually, Ordinis uses a near-black background with high-contrast white display typography at a bold, oversized scale. A frosted or rain-streaked editorial image treatment in the hero creates a distinct, atmospheric quality. Stat callout cards with a warm dark-brown accent and inline growth chart graphics provide data credibility without relying on decorative illustration. Navigation is minimal and horizontal with a solid CTA button, and a background video element is present in the build.

Ordinis is built on Webflow CMS, enabling editors to manage case studies, blog posts, and services through structured collections without touching the designer. The template includes responsive design and navigation, web fonts, a background video, a custom 404 page, and Symbols for consistent component reuse across all 21 pages. No ecommerce, forms, sliders, or lightboxes are present.

name: Cedar
long_description:
Cedar is a multi-page Webflow template built for ESG consultancies, sustainability advisory firms, and environmental strategy practices that need a credible, content-rich web presence. It positions the business around measurable impact, stakeholder trust, and regulatory compliance services, supporting lead generation through a booking-focused call-to-action structure throughout.

The template covers 20 distinct pages including a homepage, services overview, five individual service pages covering ESG strategy, sustainability reporting, carbon footprint and net zero, regulatory compliance, and stakeholder engagement, four case study pages, a blog with individual post pages, an about page, contact page, pricing page, and legal pages for privacy policy and terms of service. Content is driven by CMS collections for services, case studies, and blog posts, enabling scalable updates without rebuilding pages.

Visually, Cedar uses a light, editorial aesthetic grounded in high-contrast typography that pairs black sans-serif headings with a distinctive red monospace accent for key phrases. A halftone-treated hero illustration of a tree against layered mountain terrain sets an authoritative, nature-informed tone without relying on photography. Stat callouts such as 50-plus organizations supported, 99 percent client reporting accuracy, and 3x faster ESG readiness anchor credibility above the fold.

On the Webflow capability side, Cedar includes CMS collections for dynamic content management, a contact form, responsive navigation, a responsive slider, and CSS Grid layouts. The navbar surfaces five primary links and a cart icon, and the template includes checkout and pricing pages configured for ecommerce readiness. Responsive design and web fonts are implemented throughout, and the template is retina ready.

name: Soan
long_description:
Soan is a professional Webflow template built for consulting firms, advisory practices, and business strategy agencies that need a polished, content-rich web presence. It targets organizations that communicate complex services to senior decision-makers and need structured pages to convert visitors into qualified leads.

The template spans 24 internal pages covering the full consulting site structure: Home, About Us, Why Choose Us, Our Team, Team Details, Services, Service Details (including Business Transformation, Decision Advisory, Strategy Direction, and Leadership Consulting), Pricing, Portfolio, Portfolio Details, Careers, Career Details, Testimonials, FAQ, Blog, Blog Details, Contact Us, and a 404 page. A Style Guide and Changelog page are also included for ongoing site management.

Soan uses a light, corporate visual direction anchored by a white and off-white base, bold black typography for headings such as Clear Strategy. Confident Growth., and a strong blue accent used on calls-to-action, navigation elements, and inline UI widgets. Dashboard-style data cards featuring an active users gauge and a multi-series line chart are embedded in the hero section to reinforce analytical credibility. The navigation includes a mega-menu-style All Pages dropdown and a high-contrast dark CTA button.

Webflow-specific capabilities detected include a CMS structure supporting blog posts, service details, team profiles, portfolio projects, and career listings. The template also includes forms for email capture and contact submissions, a responsive slider, background video support, responsive navigation, web fonts, and a custom 404 page. It is fully responsive and retina ready.

name: Livin-Studio
long_description:
LivIn is a full-featured Webflow template designed for real estate agencies, property management businesses, architectural firms, and luxury housing brands. It gives teams a structured, CMS-driven foundation to present properties, services, and editorial content while guiding prospective buyers, sellers, and renters through every stage of their journey.

The template spans over 30 distinct pages including a homepage, about, services, pricing, contact, blog, and individual listing detail pages for properties such as apartments, villas, commercial spaces, and studio lofts. Properties are organized through CMS collections with filterable views by sale and rent categories. Service pages cover architectural design, interior design, project management, and urban planning, each with its own detail layout.

Visually, LivIn pairs oversized editorial typography — as seen in the full-viewport "Buy. Sell. Rent" hero — with high-contrast property photography and a structured card-based listing grid. A floating property preview card with numbered pagination, location labels, and property type tags anchors the hero section. Interactions, background video, and CSS Grid-driven layouts create a confident, editorial rhythm throughout the site that positions the brand in the premium segment.

LivIn is built on Webflow CMS for scalable property and blog content management, with forms for contact and inquiry capture, a responsive navigation, sliders for featured listings, and CSS Grid layouts throughout. Interactions and scroll-based animations add depth to the browsing experience. A style guide, changelog, instructions, and 404 page are included to support onboarding and ongoing customization.

name: ApZen
long_description:
ApZen is a Webflow template built for fintech startups, digital banking products, and mobile payment applications that need a polished marketing website. It is designed to help teams communicate product value, drive app downloads, and build credibility with prospective users through a structured, multi-page layout tailored to the finance and payments space.

The template covers 14 internal pages including a homepage, About, Pricing, Blog with individual post pages, Contact, Terms and Conditions, Privacy Policy, Instructions, Changelog, Licenses, and custom 401 and 404 error pages. The homepage is organized into nine sections spanning a hero with social proof badge, a statistics bar highlighting metrics such as 9,616 apps promoted and 5M app downloads, a key features section, a pricing section, a testimonials section, a blog preview section, and a performance tracking section. Blog content is managed through a Webflow CMS collection.

The visual direction is defined by a deep black background, oversized bold white headline typography with acid-green accent text, and a dark-matrix aesthetic reinforced by a background video element. App UI mockups are embedded within the hero section to showcase in-app analytics screens, grounding the design in a recognizable mobile product context. CTAs use pill-shaped buttons in high-contrast yellow-green and white against the dark canvas.

Built natively in Webflow, ApZen includes a CMS-driven blog, CSS Grid layouts, a contact form, responsive navigation, background video, and custom error pages. The pricing section and multi-page architecture make it straightforward to adapt for a live product launch without rebuilding the core structure.

name: Rally Padel
long_description:
Rally Padel Club is a purpose-built Webflow template designed for padel clubs, racket sports facilities, and court-booking businesses that need to convert visitors into active members and bookings. It addresses the core jobs of communicating service offerings, explaining the booking process, answering common questions, and driving sign-ups through prominent membership and court-booking calls to action.

The template covers eight distinct sections across the single-page layout, including a full-viewport hero with headline and dual CTAs, an About Us block with player and court statistics, a What You Can Do services grid, a Start Your First Match step-by-step flow, a Just Show Up convenience section, a Built by Players community proof section, and an FAQ section. Supporting pages include a style guide and changelog, giving developers a clear reference for typography and component states.

Visually, Rally Padel Club pairs a deep navy announcement bar and navigation against a high-contrast lime green accent used exclusively for primary CTA buttons, creating an immediately recognisable sports-brand identity. Large editorial typography dominates the hero, while the body copy is concise and action-oriented. The layout is structured using CSS Grid, and the responsive navigation collapses cleanly across breakpoints to support mobile court-booking journeys.

Customisation is handled entirely through Webflow's native editor without a CMS or ecommerce layer, keeping the setup lightweight. A contact and membership enquiry form is included. Responsive design and web fonts are applied throughout, and the retina-ready asset treatment ensures crisp rendering on high-density displays. The absence of CMS collections means content updates are made directly in the Designer, which suits small club teams managing their own site.

name: Soluxa
long_description:
Soluxa is a full-featured Webflow template built for independent creative agencies, branding studios, and design-led consultancies that need to present their work, services, and team with authority. It covers the complete agency website job-to-be-done: attracting ambitious founders and category-defining brands, showcasing case study results, and driving project enquiries through clear calls to action.

The template spans 20 pages including a homepage, a full work archive, five individual case study pages (Solar Bloom, Folded Futures, After Hours, Ember Protocol, North Pavilion), five service detail pages covering brand identity, strategy, campaigns, digital products, and art direction, plus About, Careers, and Contact pages, a style guide, a licences page, a privacy policy, and custom 404 and 401 error pages. The homepage is structured across ten sections including a hero, a studio reel prompt, a trusted-by logos strip, a selected work grid with metric callouts, and a services overview.

The visual direction is editorial and high-contrast: a near-black background is offset by warm amber and off-white type, with oversized serif display headings mixed against clean sans-serif body copy. Accent copy such as the word burn is set in a contrasting serif italic to create typographic tension. The layout makes deliberate use of CSS Grid for case study and service grids, while Webflow Interactions drive entrance animations and in-page motion that reinforce the studio-in-motion positioning.

Soluxa is built without CMS collections or ecommerce, keeping the structure straightforward to customise in the Webflow Designer. Detected capabilities include CSS Grid, Interactions, responsive design, responsive navigation, a custom 404 page, web fonts, and retina-ready assets. There are no native forms, sliders, or lightboxes in the detected build.

name: Freshora
long_description:
Freshora is a multi-page Webflow template built for professional cleaning service businesses, including residential and commercial operators who need to communicate service offerings, build trust, and drive consultation bookings online. It is structured around a clear conversion goal — getting visitors to schedule a 10-minute discovery call — making it well suited for solo cleaning operators, small agencies, and eco-focused service brands.

The template spans 16 pages including Home, About, Pricing, three individual service pages (Home Cleaning, Eco-Friendly Cleaning, Office Cleaning), a Blog with three published posts, Contact, a Coming Soon page, a Style Guide, 404, Privacy Policy, and Terms and Conditions. Content sections on the homepage include a social-proof hero with star rating and avatar stack, a numbered services grid, a how-it-works flow, a testimonials slider, and a plans callout anchored to a starting price.

Freshora uses oversized, compressed display typography in a dark forest green on a warm off-white background, creating a high-contrast editorial aesthetic that feels grounded and trustworthy rather than clinical. The layout relies on CSS Grid for structured section compositions, and a testimonial slider provides dynamic content cycling. Navigation includes a sticky top bar with a high-visibility CTA button in green.

The template is built with Webflow CMS, enabling the blog collection and service detail pages to be managed and scaled without touching the Designer. It includes responsive design and navigation, a responsive slider, CSS Grid, web fonts, a custom 404 page, and is retina ready. No ecommerce, background video, lightbox, or native form components are detected.

name: Qulox
long_description:
Qulox is a multi-page Webflow template built for creative agencies, design studios, and startups that need to present their services, projects, and team through a structured, professionally designed site. It is suited to businesses that need a high-impact online presence with clear content architecture across client-facing sections and utility pages.

The template covers 25 distinct pages including Home, About, Projects, Services, Blogs, Team, Price Plan, Contact, a Style Guide, Licenses, Changelog, Instruction, and a 404 page. Content-focused pages include individual service detail pages for Branding Identity, Digital Marketing, Creative Content, and Web Development, alongside individual project and blog detail pages. A price details page and a checkout route are also present, supporting a light transactional flow.

Visually, Qulox uses a full-bleed black background with oversized editorial typography as its primary design language. The hero section fragments the headline across multiple large display lines, interspersed with rounded image and glow pill treatments that embed media directly into the type layout. Supporting sections introduce a marquee-style repeating label strip, a features block combining icon labels with descriptive copy, and a Smart Building project showcase section. The overall direction is bold and typographically driven rather than grid-heavy or illustrative.

Qulox is built with Webflow CMS powering projects, services, blogs, and team collections, enabling straightforward content updates without code. The template includes a contact form, background video, responsive navigation with a hamburger menu trigger and cart icon, and web fonts. It is fully responsive and retina ready, with a custom 404 page and utility pages for onboarding included out of the box.

name: Ovelen
long_description:
Ovelen is a multi-page Webflow template built for creative agencies, digital studios, and freelance consultants who need a professional web presence that communicates authority and drives client inquiries. It covers the full agency sales funnel, from first impression through to proposal, making it a practical foundation for studios that bill on project or retainer terms.

The template spans over 30 distinct pages organised across two Home layouts, two About layouts, two Service layouts, individual Service Detail pages, a Contact page, a Featured Projects index with individual Project Detail pages, a Pricing index with individual Plan Detail pages, a Case Study index with multiple Case Study Detail pages, a Blog index with individual Blog Post pages, and utility pages including Style Guide, Changelog, Instruction, 404, Password, Privacy Policy, and Terms and Conditions. Section coverage includes Featured Projects, Working Process, Our Services, Results Showcase, Testimonials, Pricing Packages, FAQ, and Latest Blog, supported by social-proof statistics such as a 92% client success rate, 32 completed projects, and 20 years of experience.

Visually, Ovelen uses a dark, full-bleed aesthetic with oversized display typography set at editorial scale, layered image cards with blur and glitch-style treatments, a live location and timestamp bar in the navigation, category pill labels, and a stacked avatar plus star-rating trust signal. The layout combines large kinetic headline text with structured informational blocks, giving the design a bold, gallery-quality feel that positions the agency as a premium creative partner.

On the Webflow side, the template is built with CMS collections powering projects, case studies, blog posts, and pricing plans, enabling straightforward content updates without touching the Designer. It includes contact and booking forms, responsive navigation, a responsive slider, media lightbox, CSS Grid layouts, web fonts, and a custom 404 page, with the full design confirmed as retina ready and responsive across breakpoints.

name: Aesthiva
long_description:
Aesthiva is a multi-page Webflow template designed for med spas, aesthetic clinics, and skincare practices that want to present a calm, consultation-first brand experience. It gives clinic owners and practitioners the structure to showcase services, publish treatment detail pages, and drive bookings through clearly placed calls to action, all without relying on a developer after launch.

The template covers nine internal pages including a homepage, treatment detail pages such as a dedicated Botox and Wrinkle Relaxers page, a blog with individual post pages covering topics like pre-consultation preparation and post-treatment maintenance, a style guide, a custom 404 page, a changelog, and a licenses page. The homepage alone spans fourteen sections including a hero with a scrolling marquee, a trust indicators bar, an about summary with client and experience statistics, a services overview, a popular treatments block, a step-by-step process section, a results section, a team section, a pricing starting points section, and a client testimonials section.

Visually, Aesthiva uses a warm, dark-toned hero against a cream off-white body palette, combining editorial serif display type with clean sans-serif body copy. A wavy SVG marquee text element runs across the hero, and a background video is layered into the opening section. The overall aesthetic is restrained and premium, consistent with a brand positioning around natural-looking results and unhurried care.

On the technical side, Aesthiva is built with Webflow CMS for blog posts and treatment pages, a contact form, CSS Grid layouts, responsive navigation with a hamburger menu, a custom 404 page, and background video support. It is fully responsive and retina ready, with web fonts applied throughout.

name: WaveForge
long_description:
WaveForge is a full-featured Webflow template designed for creative agencies, digital studios, and design-led service businesses that need to present their work, expertise, and team with visual authority. It gives studios a complete online presence anchored around project showcasing, service communication, and client conversion through a contact-driven structure.

The template spans 16 internal pages including Home, About, Projects (with five individual CMS-driven project detail pages), Blog (with three article pages), Contact, a Style Guide, Changelog, License utility page, and a custom 404. Visible section coverage on the home page includes a full-screen hero, a services overview listing UX/UI Design, Development, Brand Design, and SEO Optimization, a process section, a team section, and a statistics block citing 17+ websites launched, 1.5M+ users reached, and 98% client satisfaction.

The visual direction is dark and cinematic, built around a deep navy palette with electric blue accents and a large-scale AI-rendered 3D figure as the hero centerpiece. Typography is editorial and oversized, with bracketed navigation labels adding a distinct typographic personality. CTAs such as Start your project and Contact are consistently placed to funnel visitors toward conversion. A background video and responsive slider are present, reinforcing the high-production aesthetic.

WaveForge is built on Webflow CMS, enabling the Projects and Blog collections to be managed and scaled without touching the designer. The template also includes forms, a responsive navigation, background video, a slider, web fonts, a custom 404 page, and is fully responsive and retina ready.

name: Bellagio
long_description:
Bellagio is a multi-page Webflow template built for AI-powered SaaS products, specifically scheduling and productivity tools. It gives founders and marketing teams a polished, ready-to-launch site that communicates automation benefits, platform integrations, and enterprise-grade features to potential users and buyers.

The template spans 12 internal pages including Home, Features, About, Blog, Pricing, Contact, and individual blog post pages, all supported by a CMS collection for dynamic content publishing. Key sections visible across the site include a hero with social-proof rating and CTA, a trusted-by logos band, a platform integrations block, feature highlights covering smart actions, workflow automation, API integration, 24/7 support, data analytics, multi-language support, and custom enterprise workflows, plus a blog showcase section.

Visually, Bellagio uses a deep black and dark-purple gradient aesthetic with high-contrast white typography and pink-red accent colors drawn from the brand mark. The hero presents stacked UI card mockups suggesting an in-app command interface, reinforcing the product narrative. Rated 4.9/5 social proof and avatar clusters anchor credibility at the fold. Layout is structured and editorial, using CSS Grid to align feature and integration content cleanly across breakpoints. Both mobile and desktop support are explicitly called out in the footer area.

Bellagio is built with Webflow CMS enabling the blog post collection to be managed and scaled without code. CSS Grid powers the multi-column layout sections. Responsive navigation collapses correctly across device sizes. The template does not include ecommerce, forms, video backgrounds, sliders, or lightboxes, keeping the codebase lean and fast to customize for a new SaaS brand.

name: Dentalflow
long_description:
Dentalflow is a purpose-built Webflow template designed for dental clinics, individual dentists, and dental teams who need a professional website that actively drives appointment bookings. It addresses the core job of presenting services credibly, building patient trust, and providing clear pathways to contact and scheduling — all without requiring custom development.

The template includes over 20 pages organized across clearly defined categories. Main pages cover three distinct homepage variants, an About page, a Booking page, three Contact page layouts, a Team page with individual team member profiles, a Testimonials page, a Pricing page, and a FAQs page. Blog coverage spans three layout variants plus a Blog Post detail page. Utility pages include a Style Guide, 404, Coming Soon, and Password Protected pages, giving the template comprehensive coverage for a full clinic website launch.

Visually, Dentalflow uses a white and deep navy palette accented with a signature purple, applied consistently across hero sections, service cards, and call-to-action buttons. Headlines use a heavy serif-influenced weight that pairs with clean body copy, creating a tone that feels clinically trustworthy yet approachable. The prominent Book an Appointment button appears persistently in the navigation, reinforcing the conversion goal throughout every page.

Dentalflow is built with CSS Grid for structured, responsive layouts and includes functional contact and booking forms. Responsive navigation handles the multi-page structure cleanly across breakpoints. The template ships with over 25 style components for consistent design reuse, and the three-variant approach across homepages, blogs, and contact pages gives teams meaningful layout choices without additional design work.

name: Zyven
long_description:
Zyven is a single-product brand template built for consumer electronics and audio hardware companies looking to showcase wireless headphones with a high-impact, retail-ready web presence. It suits direct-to-consumer audio brands, hardware startups, and product marketing teams that need a polished storefront-style site without a full ecommerce build.

The template covers ten internal pages including a homepage, a product listing page, three individual product detail pages for named SKUs, a contact page, a style guide, a 404 page, and admin utility pages for instructions, changelog, and license. The homepage is structured across ten sections: a scrolling promotional announcement bar promoting a first-order discount, a hero section with a three-slide product carousel, a featured products grid, a lifestyle-focused daily living section, a technology specification section, a close-up product detail gallery, and a conversion-focused upgrade call-to-action section. A persistent trust bar surfaces free shipping, a one-year warranty, and seven-day returns.

The visual direction is dark and bold throughout, built on a near-black canvas with high-contrast white typography, red accent highlights on interactive elements and card borders, and product photography staged against dark backgrounds. Navigation is clean and minimal with four primary links. CTAs use solid red and outlined white button treatments. The product carousel presents headphones in multiple colorways — silver, lime green, and white — against consistent dark framing, reinforcing a premium audio aesthetic.

Zyven is built with Webflow CMS to manage product entries and page content dynamically, making it straightforward to add or update product variants without rebuilding pages. It includes a responsive navigation, a responsive slider, and a contact form. The template is retina ready and ships with web fonts and a custom 404 page.

name: Zelect
long_description:
Zelect is a Webflow template built for SaaS companies and tech startups that need a polished, conversion-focused website without building from scratch. It is designed for teams that want multiple layout options, broad page coverage, and a bold dark aesthetic that positions their product as a credible, modern platform from day one.

The template includes 23 internal pages covering three distinct homepage variants, product pages, about, pricing tiers, blog index and post pages, contact pages, FAQ, style guide, changelog, and utility pages including 404 and password protection. With 80+ pre-built sections and blocks, teams can assemble or swap layouts across the full site rather than rebuilding components individually.

Zelect uses a dark color scheme with high-contrast typography and structured grid-based layouts throughout. The navigation supports dropdown menus across Home, Product, Pages, Blog, and Contact categories, with a persistent announcement bar and a prominent contact CTA. Section compositions follow a feature-highlight and stats pattern visible in the hero and supporting blocks, giving product pages a clear hierarchy.

On the Webflow capability side, Zelect includes CSS Grid for layout control, responsive design and navigation, a responsive slider, and forms for contact and lead capture. It ships with symbols for consistent component reuse, custom web fonts, and retina-ready assets. No CMS collections or ecommerce functionality are present, keeping the build lightweight and straightforward to customize.

name: Krafthub
long_description:
KraftHub is a fully structured online education platform template built for founders and independent educators who want to launch a course marketplace or learning community without starting from scratch. It targets self-taught creators, bootcamp operators, and cohort-based learning businesses that need a credible, content-rich web presence ready to scale.

The template ships with nine distinct pages covering the home, About Us, course listing, individual course detail pages for subjects including content strategy, no-code automation, and prompt engineering, a premium membership tier page labeled KraftHub+, a Blog, and a Contact page. The home page surfaces a live community activity feed, a 200+ creator-led lessons stat block, testimonials under a Word from our Members section, and dual calls to action directing visitors to explore courses or register.

Visually, KraftHub uses a bold typographic hierarchy anchored by a dark navy and high-contrast orange accent palette. The hero uses a geometric tile background pattern with oversized display text. Stat blocks alternate between dark and orange card treatments, and real-time community notifications are rendered as dark-card UI components that reinforce the platform feel. The overall aesthetic reads as bold and modern with deliberate product-UI references throughout.

On the Webflow capability side, KraftHub uses CMS collections to power the course catalog and blog, CSS Grid for the bento-style stat and card layouts, background video, and a contact form. Navigation is fully responsive with a clear mobile entry point via the Join for Free CTA. All pages are built with Symbols for consistent headers and footers, and the template is retina ready and built with web fonts throughout.

name: Emoko Studio
long_description:
Emoko Studio is a multi-page Webflow template designed for creative agencies, design studios, and freelancers who need a polished online presence to present their work, services, and expertise. It targets studios offering brand strategy, product design, web development, and digital marketing, giving them a structured platform to attract and convert clients.

The template covers 20 internal pages including a Home, Projects archive with individual project case study pages, Services, About, Articles blog with single post pages, Contact, and utility pages such as a Style Guide, Changelog, License, 404, and password-protected page. Content is driven by CMS collections for projects and blog posts, making it straightforward to populate and maintain at scale.

Visually, Emoko Studio leads with a high-contrast, dramatic aesthetic built around warm amber tones, motion-blurred photography, and oversized display typography featuring a registered trademark lockup. The layout uses CSS Grid throughout and incorporates a slider, media lightbox for project imagery, and section groupings covering Featured Projects, Services We Provide, Trusted Partner social proof, Client Reviews, Pricing Plans, and FAQ.

On the customization side, the template is fully responsive with a responsive navigation and slider, retina-ready assets, web fonts, CMS collections for projects and articles, a media lightbox for portfolio imagery, a custom 404 page, and Symbols for consistent component reuse across pages. No ecommerce or background video is present.

name: Max Mavion
long_description:
Max Morgan is a Webflow template built specifically for fashion and editorial photographers who need a professional online presence that communicates creative identity, showcases image work, and converts prospective clients. The template is structured around a personal brand narrative, making it well suited for freelance photographers, studio creatives, and visual artists working across editorial, campaign, and runway disciplines.

The template covers six primary content areas visible across its pages: a hero section with a full-bleed typographic statement, an About section that communicates creative philosophy and a highlighted client return rate metric, a Portfolio section backed by a CMS collection with individual project entries including named shoots and locations, a Published Works section for press and recognition features, a Testimonials section for social proof, and a Contact page. Three sample CMS portfolio entries are included, demonstrating the expected content model for project-level detail pages.

The visual direction is rooted in a high-contrast black and white palette with large-scale display typography and editorial-grade image placement. The layout uses CSS Grid to arrange portfolio imagery in structured asymmetric compositions, and a slider component provides horizontal browsing within collections. Lightbox functionality enables full-screen image viewing without leaving the page, preserving the gallery experience. Navigation is clean and restrained, with a monogram logo mark and a minimal link set that keeps focus on the visual content.

Customization is supported through a CMS collection powering the portfolio entries, allowing new project pages to be added without rebuilding page structure. Responsive design and responsive navigation ensure consistent presentation across screen sizes. The template also includes a style guide and changelog page, and uses web fonts and Retina-ready assets throughout.

name: HelloBot
long_description:
HelloBot is a multi-page Webflow template built for AI chatbot platforms, SaaS tools, and customer support software companies looking to communicate their product value and convert visitors into users. It is designed to present intelligent automation services, showcase integrations, and guide prospects through a clear commercial journey from awareness to sign-up.

The template spans nine internal pages including Home, Features, Integrations, Pricing, About Us, Contact Us, Terms and Conditions, Licenses, and a Changelog. The home page alone carries sixteen sections covering a hero with dual CTAs, a trusted-partners logo bar, a feature breakdown, a multilingual support callout, an integrations overview, a social proof section with customer testimonials, and a closing conversion banner. Navigation links to Features, Integrations, and Pricing indicate that each receives dedicated page treatment.

Visually, HelloBot uses a light, airy palette built around soft blue gradients and white surfaces. Typography is bold and large-scale in hero headings, tapering to clean body copy. A product UI mockup showing a workflow canvas with nodes and conditional logic blocks is embedded in the hero section, grounding the abstract chatbot proposition in a concrete product screenshot. The layout relies on CSS Grid for structured, aligned content blocks throughout.

Customization is supported through Webflow CMS, enabling dynamic content management for sections such as testimonials, integration listings, and changelog entries. Responsive design and responsive navigation are included, ensuring the template adapts across device sizes. Web fonts and retina-ready assets contribute to a polished, high-resolution presentation across all breakpoints.

name: Zorvix
long_description:
Zorvix is a full-featured Webflow template built for digital agencies and creative studios that need to present services, showcase client work, and attract new business online. It covers the complete agency content model — from positioning and team introductions through to service detail pages, project case studies, a blog, and a contact section — making it a practical starting point for agencies offering web development, UI/UX design, SEO, graphic design, marketing copywriting, and video production.

The template spans 21 internal pages including dedicated service pages for six distinct disciplines, six project case study pages, blog post and blog category pages, an About page, and a Contact page. The homepage structures nine sections covering a hero, an about summary with animated counters, a services overview, a team section, a portfolio preview, pricing, a social proof section citing 500,000-plus users, a latest stories feed, and a call-to-action panel. CMS collections visibly power the projects, blog posts, and blog categories.

Zorvix uses a bold dark aesthetic throughout — a near-black background with white type and pill-shaped navigation labels — creating a high-contrast, editorial feel suited to agencies positioning themselves as premium or forward-thinking. Vertical social media links and a rotated community label add considered typographic detail to the hero layout. Interactions and animated number counters reinforce a dynamic, performance-led brand impression.

On the Webflow capability side, Zorvix includes CMS collections for projects and blog content, contact forms, a responsive slider, CSS Grid-based layouts, and interaction-driven animations. Navigation is fully responsive with a hamburger menu for mobile. The template does not include ecommerce functionality.

name: Zenvia
long_description:
Zenvia is a multi-page Webflow template built for creative agencies, digital studios, and freelancers who offer services such as UX/UI design, motion design, branding, and development. It provides a complete site structure out of the box, enabling studios to present their work, communicate their offer, and capture leads without building from scratch.

The template spans 25 internal pages including Home, About, Services, Blog, Projects, Pricing, Contact, and a full set of detail pages for individual projects, services, blog posts, and pricing plans. Utility pages cover a style guide, instructions, changelog, license, password protection, and a custom 404. Section coverage on the home page includes a hero, featured projects, an agency introduction, a services overview, a pricing summary, a testimonials section, an FAQ, and a blog previews hub.

The visual direction pairs large editorial serif headings with a predominantly white canvas, soft ambient colour gradients in the hero, and vivid full-bleed photography in the project grid. Navigation uses a sticky bar with a dropdown Pages menu and a high-contrast call-to-action button. Arrow-accented pill buttons appear consistently across CTAs, reinforcing a considered, contemporary brand language without relying on decorative illustration.

Zenvia is built on Webflow CMS, powering the blog, project portfolio, and service detail collections for easy content updates. A contact form handles lead capture, and a responsive slider is included for dynamic content display. The layout uses CSS Grid for structured section composition, and the template is fully responsive with a mobile-ready navigation pattern. Background video support is detected, adding motion to hero or feature sections.

name: Cimpix
long_description:
Cimpix is a multi-page Webflow template built for creative agencies, digital studios, and service-oriented businesses that need a polished, professional web presence. It is structured to showcase services, team, case studies, and editorial content within a single cohesive system, making it well-suited for studios positioning around quality, consistency, and measurable results.

The template spans 23 internal pages covering Home, About, Services, Projects, Blogs, Team, and Contact, alongside individual detail pages for services such as brand strategy, digital design, web development, and growth marketing. Project and blog detail pages follow a consistent CMS-driven structure, and utility pages include a style guide, changelog, instruction page, licenses page, a custom 404, and a password page. Sections visible across the site address brand positioning, feature highlights, and a brand elevation narrative framed around digital excellence.

Visually, Cimpix uses a warm amber and near-black palette with large editorial typography and a vertical scrolling ticker of precision-oriented descriptors including Refined, Crisp, Calculated, and Tailored. The hero pairs an oversized headline with a floating laptop mockup set on a rock formation, a portrait video thumbnail with a pause control, and a Confirmed social-proof badge. The navigation includes a high-contrast Contact button with an arrow icon and a hamburger menu for secondary links.

Cimpix is built with Webflow CMS collections powering the projects, services, and blog sections, enabling editors to add or update content without touching the designer. Forms are included for contact functionality, background video is present in the hero section, responsive navigation handles both primary and utility links, and web fonts and retina-ready assets are applied throughout.

name: Voidlab
long_description:
Voidlab is a multi-page Webflow template built for digital growth agencies, creative studios, and UI/UX design firms that need a visually striking online presence. It supports the full agency sales funnel — from brand storytelling and service communication to portfolio display and client conversion — within a single cohesive site structure.

The template covers 8 internal pages: Home, About, Services, Work, Blog, Contact, and three individual blog post pages. Key sections observed across the site include a hero with agency positioning, a services showcase titled The Magic We Deliver, a selected works portfolio, a social proof section referencing 5k+ businesses, a pricing plan section, a blog and articles listing, and a closing call-to-action panel. CMS collections power the blog and likely the portfolio, allowing editors to add and manage content without touching the designer.

Visually, Voidlab leads with a vivid pink primary palette, oversized black display typography, and illustrated hand-drawn sticker motifs scattered across the hero. The layout pairs an arched editorial image frame with staggered text columns and rotating badge elements, creating a playful yet professionally structured aesthetic. Navigation is horizontal with a contrasting CTA button, and CSS Grid drives the underlying layout precision throughout.

On the technical side, Voidlab includes Webflow CMS for blog and work collections, a contact form, CSS Grid-based layouts, responsive navigation, and web fonts. The template is ecommerce-free and contains no background video or lightbox components, keeping load performance lean while delivering a high-impact creative agency presentation out of the box.

name: Orlexa
long_description:
Orlexa is a multi-page Webflow template designed for clinics, hospitals, and multi-specialty medical practices that need a professional web presence to attract patients and communicate trust. It addresses the core jobs of showcasing medical staff, listing departments, publishing health content, and directing visitors toward appointment booking.

The template spans 15 pages including a homepage, a doctors directory, individual doctor profile pages, a blog with individual post pages, and a contact page, alongside utility pages for style guide, instructions, changelog, license, and a custom 404. The homepage presents animated stat counters for client satisfaction, years of experience, and patient reviews, a scrolling department ticker covering Cardiology, Psychiatry, Oncology, Neuro Medicine, Gynecology, Orthopedic Surgery, and Neurology, and a slider-based testimonial or trust section.

The visual direction uses a deep forest-green primary palette against white content panels, creating a clinical yet approachable tone. A prominent yellow-green call-to-action button for booking appointments provides strong contrast. Typography is bold and oversized for headings, with supporting body copy kept concise. Floating stat cards with a trusted-rate callout add visual hierarchy on the hero section, and a responsive navigation hamburger menu is visible on mobile breakpoints.

Orlexa is built with Webflow CMS powering the doctor profiles and blog posts, enabling editors to add or update staff and articles without touching the designer. A responsive slider handles rotating content sections. The template includes a custom 404 page, web fonts, retina-ready assets, and fully responsive navigation, making it ready to deploy for a medical practice with minimal configuration.

name: Loguna
long_description:
Loguna is a Webflow template designed for therapists, psychologists, counselors, and mental wellness practices that need a polished, credible online presence. It covers the full range of content a private practice or wellness clinic requires, from communicating specializations and practitioner credentials to capturing leads through contact forms and sharing thought-leadership through a blog.

The template ships with over 21 internal pages spanning three homepage variants, three service listing variants, three contact variants, dedicated service detail pages for offerings such as individual therapy, group therapy workshops, family and couples therapy, anxiety and depression support, and crisis intervention, plus a blog with a detail page, a pricing page, an about page, a styleguide, changelog, licensing page, and a custom 404 page. Service and blog content is driven by Webflow CMS, making it straightforward to add, edit, or remove entries without touching the design.

Visually, Loguna leads with a full-width photographic hero overlaid with a muted dark treatment, large editorial typography, and a floating social-proof card showing a 5.0 star rating and client count. Sections beneath establish trust through statistics such as 30 years of experience, 2,000 sessions completed, and 98 percent client satisfaction, alongside benefit callouts covering confidentiality, personalized care, experienced professionals, and flexible sessions. The palette and type choices project calm authority appropriate for a healthcare or counseling context.

Built entirely in Webflow, Loguna includes responsive design and navigation, a responsive slider, media lightbox, CSS Grid layouts, and native Webflow forms for contact and inquiry capture. The CMS architecture means service and blog collections scale without layout work, and the multi-layout page structure lets practitioners choose the homepage and contact arrangement that best fits their brand.

name: Jared
long_description:
Jared is a Webflow template built for digital production agencies and creative studios that need a high-impact web presence to attract brand clients. It positions the studio clearly around core services — brand identity, web and app experience, motion production, and rapid concept prototyping — making it immediately useful for agencies that want visitors to understand their offer without friction.

The template spans 18 pages covering a homepage, about, contact, a projects section with five individual case study pages, a blog with six individual post pages, and utility pages including a style guide, changelog, and license page. Section coverage on the homepage includes a hero, client logos, expertise listing, results metrics, work showcase, client testimonials, blog preview, and FAQ — giving agencies a complete narrative arc on a single scroll.

The visual direction is bold and editorial: oversized display typography in uppercase, a near-black background with neon yellow accent elements, and unconventional image treatments including 3D-perspective photo boxes that create depth without video. Navigation uses bracketed labels and a full-screen menu overlay, reinforcing a considered, studio-grade aesthetic throughout.

Jared is built with Webflow CMS powering both the project and blog collections, enabling straightforward content updates without touching the Designer. Responsive navigation is included across all breakpoints. The template does not include ecommerce, forms, sliders, or background video, keeping the build lightweight and focused on presentation and content management.

name: Aurix
long_description:
Aurix is a multi-layout Webflow template designed for creative agencies, branding studios, and digital design teams that need a polished, high-impact web presence. It supports the full agency sales cycle, from communicating services and showcasing client work to capturing leads and presenting pricing, all within a single cohesive design system.

The template spans 24 internal pages including three Home variants, three About Us variants, three Contact variants, a Work index, six individual portfolio case pages covering disciplines such as UX/UI design, branding and identity, mobile app design, web development, and e-commerce development, a Blog with three published post pages, a Pricing page, a Style Guide, and utility pages for licenses, changelog, and instructions. CMS collections power the portfolio and blog, enabling straightforward content management at scale.

The visual direction is dark and editorial, anchored by a near-black hero canvas, a spectrum light-ray accent, and a dimensional 3D cube device that frames a fashion editorial image. Typography is oversized and high-contrast, with service tags rendered as pill-shaped capsules along the hero baseline. A horizontal marquee treatment carries the studio name at large scale, and partner and project sections maintain the bold typographic rhythm throughout the scroll.

Built on CSS Grid and Webflow CMS, Aurix supports responsive navigation, contact forms, and web fonts. The multi-layout page structure lets teams mix and match home, about, and contact variants to match their brand tone without rebuilding from scratch. Responsive design is applied across all pages, ensuring consistent presentation on mobile and desktop.

name: Rewire
long_description:
Rewire is a multi-page Webflow template designed for AI SaaS products, specifically content repurposing and distribution platforms targeting creators, agencies, and publishing teams. It provides a complete site structure to communicate product value, capture leads, and drive free trial conversions without requiring extensive custom development.

The template includes 16 internal pages covering the core marketing funnel: Home, About, Pricing, Features, Blog, Contact, Integrations, Request a Demo, FAQs, Waitlist, Privacy Policy, and utility pages including a style guide, changelog, licenses, and error states (404, 401). The home page is structured across 12 sections, moving from a hero with dual CTAs through a product demo visual, a problem-framing section, a platform-native content conversion feature showcase, a user persona section labeled Who is Recast for, a preview panel, and a social proof milestone callout at 75,000 users.

Visually, Rewire uses a high-contrast dark foundation with a black-and-white typographic hierarchy broken by a signature neon green accent applied to key headline words and button states. The hero headline uses large display type with an inline highlight block to draw attention to the brand promise. Platform icons for Vimeo, YouTube, Snapchat, LinkedIn, and Tumblr appear as social proof of multi-channel reach. A background video section anchors the lower hero area, and a lightbox is used to surface example output previews inline.

Rewire is built on CSS Grid for precise layout control and ships with responsive navigation, background video, and media lightbox support out of the box. It does not include CMS collections or ecommerce functionality. The style guide, changelog, and license utility pages are included to support ongoing customization and handoff workflows within Webflow.

name: Tafix
long_description:
Tafix is a multi-page Webflow template designed for creative agencies, digital studios, and brand consultancies that need a polished, high-impact web presence. Its primary job is to communicate strategic and creative capability while moving visitors toward a contact or consultation, supported by dedicated pages for services, projects, team, pricing, and a blog.

The template ships with 23 internal pages covering the full agency content model: a Home page with a marquee headline and video presentation panel, an About page, a Projects portfolio with individual case study detail pages, a Services section with individual service detail pages, a Blog with article detail pages, a Team page, a Pricing page with individual plan detail pages, and a Contact page. Utility pages include a Style Guide, Changelog, Licenses, Password, and a custom 404, giving the template a complete, production-ready structure.

Visually, Tafix leads with a pure-black background, chrome and silver 3D sculptural hero objects, oversized oversized display typography, and amber accent details on interactive elements such as the diamond-icon CTA buttons. A fullscreen marquee scrolls the brand proposition continuously, and a video presentation thumbnail sits inline in the hero. The navigation exposes a top-level Pages dropdown with the full CMS and utility page set, and a cart icon signals the ecommerce-ready structure.

On the capability side, Tafix uses Webflow CMS to manage projects, services, and blog content through structured collection pages. Forms are present for contact and lead capture. A responsive slider, background video, and responsive navigation are all detected. The template is retina ready, uses web fonts, includes custom 404 handling, and is built with Symbols for efficient editing across pages.

name: Zinve
long_description:
Zinve is a comprehensive multi-page Webflow template built for design agencies, UI/UX studios, and creative consultancies that need a polished web presence to attract clients and showcase work. It positions its fictional agency around brand elevation, product design, and interface work, giving real studios a ready-made content structure to adapt quickly.

The template spans over 30 internal pages including Home, About, Service, Project, Teams, Blog, Pricing, and Contact, plus CMS-driven detail pages for individual services, projects, team members, and blog posts. Utility pages such as a Style Guide, Changelog, License, Instruction, and 404 are also included. Service offerings are organised into Interface Design, Product Design, and UI/UX Design categories, each with a dedicated detail page. The project section showcases named case studies including Orbit, Prism, Nexus, Flux, Echo, and Vertex entries driven by the CMS.

Visually, Zinve leans into a high-contrast editorial aesthetic with oversized display typography, a bold black-and-white base palette punctuated by accent colours, and a grid-based mosaic layout on the homepage that layers editorial photography with product imagery. The navigation uses pill-style indicators and a slide-out or overlay contact panel. Section headings such as Play, Reel, Crafted Uniquely, and Evolve Constantly signal a rhythm-driven scrolling experience. A prominent stats callout highlights $200M raised by clients and 15 years of experience.

On the Webflow side, CMS collections power projects, blog posts, team members, and service pages, enabling straightforward content management without rebuilding layouts. The template includes forms for contact and booking, a responsive slider, media lightbox for portfolio imagery, CSS Grid layouts, responsive navigation, and three pricing product pages. Web fonts and retina-ready assets are used throughout.

name: Wellco
long_description:
Wellco Wellness Studio is a fully structured Webflow template designed for nutrition coaches, wellness consultants, and health-focused businesses that need to present services, sell products, and capture leads in a single cohesive site. It covers the full scope of a wellness brand: from free consultation CTAs and program enrollment prompts to an e-commerce-ready product catalogue and appointment booking flows.

The template ships with 20 internal pages observed across the crawl, including Home, About Us, Services, Services Details, Product, Product Details, Blog, Blog Details, Privacy Policy, Terms and Conditions, 404, and Contact. Content is organized through clearly named CMS collections for services posts, product listings, and blog articles, allowing editors to publish new entries without touching the designer. Section coverage on the homepage includes a hero with social proof ratings, an origin story block, a services overview, a benefits grid, a product showcase, a testimonials strip citing over 4,200 members, and an FAQ accordion.

The visual direction uses a soft mint and deep forest-green palette throughout, with a certified badge overlay on the hero image and dual five-star rating badges reinforcing credibility above the fold. Navigation is structured with a dropdown Pages menu, a cart icon, and a prominent Get Free Consultation CTA button, maintaining clear hierarchy across breakpoints. Typography is bold and large-scale on headings, contrasted with compact descriptive body copy.

Customization is supported by Webflow CMS for services, products, and blog content, a responsive slider, contact and consultation forms, responsive navigation with dropdown support, web fonts, a custom 404 page, and symbols for reusable components. The template is retina ready and fully responsive across device sizes.

name: TeamUp
long_description:
TeamUp is a multi-page Webflow template built for HR consultancies, recruiting agencies, and workforce services firms that help companies hire for fit and reduce early turnover. The template communicates a clear value proposition around end-to-end recruitment, onboarding support, and HR operations, making it well suited for small-to-mid-size HR service providers positioning themselves against generalist staffing solutions.

The template spans 11 internal pages including Home, About, Services, Contact, a Style Guide, and six individual service detail pages covering hiring process improvement, employer branding and job post optimization, HR documentation and compliance, onboarding and first-week setup, skills assessment support, and screening and interview coordination. The homepage includes a hero section with social proof statistics (120+ companies, 85% 90-day retention, 1,500+ placements), a featured client testimonial, a services overview, a past clients section, and a prominent call-to-action section. Twelve total sections provide thorough coverage for a service-led business.

The visual direction is clean and editorial, using a predominantly white background, heavy black serif display headings, and a dark navy call-to-action button. Photography is used in a split or offset layout on the hero, giving the design a grounded, professional feel without relying on illustration or decoration. The tone is direct and performance-focused, reinforced by metric callouts and a client quote attributed to a named operations manager.

The template is built with Webflow CMS, enabling service pages to be managed dynamically. A contact form is included for lead capture. The navigation is fully responsive with Home, About, Services, and Contact Us links. Background video capability is detected, and the template is built with web fonts and is retina ready, providing a solid foundation for customization within the Webflow Designer.

name: Kata Studio
long_description:
Kata Studio is a Webflow template designed for AI SaaS startups, productivity tool makers, and multi-model chat application companies. It targets founders and product teams who need to communicate a workspace-style product with distinct user segments, converting visitors through clear use-case positioning and a structured pricing section.

The template spans ten internal pages covering core product marketing surfaces: a homepage, a product detail page, a pricing page, three use-case landing pages tailored to agencies, product teams, and support teams, plus login, register, contact, and a style guide. The homepage alone delivers twelve sections including a hero with an interactive chat input mockup, a features walkthrough numbered across three steps, a social proof block citing 80,000 users, and model-switcher iconography referencing multi-modal AI support.

Visually, Kata Studio uses a muted warm-beige palette anchored by a painterly landscape hero image, deep forest-green typography, and rounded UI card components that echo a real product interface. The chat input mock with Attach and Model controls, alongside recognizable AI model icons, grounds the design in authentic product context rather than generic SaaS illustration. Navigation uses a minimal top bar with dropdown use-case routing and dual CTA buttons distinguishing log-in from get-started flows.

Built natively in Webflow, the template includes responsive design, responsive navigation, web fonts, retina-ready assets, symbols for reusable components, and a functional contact form. CMS collections and ecommerce are not enabled, keeping the structure lightweight and straightforward to customize. The style guide page provides a documented component reference to accelerate brand adaptation.

name: Solena Archived 20260519
long_description:
Solena is a multi-page Webflow template built for luxury spas, wellness retreats, and treatment studios that need to present services professionally and convert visitors into booked appointments. It provides a complete content foundation so spa owners and wellness brands can launch quickly without rebuilding core pages from scratch.

The template covers 17 internal pages organised across main pages and CMS-driven collections. Main pages include Home, About, Our Team, Services, Blog, and Contact. CMS collection pages handle individual team member profiles, individual service detail pages, and individual blog post pages. Utility pages include a Password page, Licenses, Changelog, and a custom 404 error page. Section coverage on the homepage includes a hero, a spa services overview, a why-choose-us block, a relaxation feature section, an appointment booking form, a pricing plans section, an FAQ accordion, and a partners strip.

The visual direction is editorial and high-contrast: a muted olive green sidebar panel sits alongside large-format dark atmospheric interior photography, with oversized serif display type set in all-caps for hero headings. The colour palette pairs warm earth tones and deep browns with crisp white typography. Contact details, booking support, and opening hours are surfaced directly in the hero footer bar, reducing friction for first-time visitors seeking to book.
