Customisation is supported by a full CMS setup covering services, team members, and blog posts, allowing content updates without touching the designer. The template includes a booking appointment form, a responsive slider, CSS Grid-based layouts, responsive navigation with an off-canvas menu, and web fonts. It is retina ready and fully responsive across breakpoints.

name: Clarity Catalyst Archived 20260519
long_description:

It is structured around the specific needs of ICF and AC-aligned training centres that offer tiered programme pathways, mentoring, masterclasses, and ongoing professional development resources.

The template covers 18 internal pages including dedicated programme pages for a Free Introduction to Coaching Skills, a Diploma in Integrative Coaching, an ACC to PCC top-up programme, Executive Coaching, Career Transitions, and Team Coaching. Supporting pages include Master Classes, Community, Resources, About Us, and Contact. The Resources section is backed by a CMS collection, with visible post pages covering topics relevant to coaching professionals. Key homepage sections include a featured programmes grid, client logos strip, testimonials from the coaching community, a latest articles and media section, and an FAQ block.

The visual direction uses a high-contrast dark aesthetic anchored by black, white, and bold yellow accents. The hero features a full-bleed black-and-white photographic background with a prominent email capture form and a clear call-to-action button. Typography is large-scale and assertive, reinforcing authority and professional credibility. A responsive slider and media lightbox appear in the content sections, and background video is present in the template.

Customisation is supported through Webflow CMS powering the resources and blog content, enabling editors to publish articles, podcasts, and videos without touching the designer. The template includes forms for programme registration and free event sign-up, a responsive navigation with a dropdown coaching programmes menu, CSS Grid for layout structure, symbols for reusable components, and retina-ready web fonts throughout.

name: Scably Archived 20260519
long_description:
Scably is a multi-page Webflow template built for business consultants, advisory firms, and professional services companies that need to communicate expertise, methodology, and measurable client outcomes. It gives founders and agency leads a structured digital presence to attract clients and articulate strategic value across every stage of the buyer journey.

The template covers 14 internal pages drawn from evidence: four dedicated service pages including Strategic Planning, Marketing Analysis, Leadership Coaching, and Finance Management; four case study pages covering real-world growth scenarios; three blog article pages focused on revenue acceleration, operational excellence, and strategic growth; plus a style guide, licenses, and changelog page. The homepage sequences through an About section, a Why Choose Us block, a Data Driven Approach highlight, a Long Term Partnership value statement, a metric showcase featuring 2x and 4x growth figures, and a Strategic Partner in Sustainable Growth closing section.

Scably uses a warm neutral palette anchored by cream, white, and gold tones set against full-bleed team photography and a background video hero. The typographic pairing combines a serif display face for large headings with a clean sans-serif for body copy, creating editorial weight without sacrificing readability. A floating strategic planning card overlaid on the hero image signals credibility immediately on load. Navigation is minimal with four top-level links and a high-contrast Contact Us call-to-action button.

All case studies and blog articles are managed through Webflow CMS collections, allowing content to be updated without touching the designer. The template also includes a contact form, a responsive slider, responsive navigation, and background video support. It is fully responsive and retina ready, with web fonts and Symbols used throughout for consistent component reuse.

name: Pilgel Archived 20260519
long_description:
Pilgel is a multi-page Webflow template built for AI-driven creative agencies and digital studios that need to present services, showcase work, and convert ambitious brands into clients. It is structured around a clear commercial narrative — positioning the agency as the intersection of artificial intelligence and design thinking — making it well suited for studios offering branding, digital design, and AI strategy services.

The template ships with 22 internal pages spanning Home, About, Services, Projects, Blogs, Team, Price Plan, and Contact, each with a corresponding detail page for services, projects, and blog posts. Utility pages include a style guide, changelog, licences, a password-protected page, and a custom 404. A CMS structure supports the blog, projects, and services collections, enabling scalable content management without rebuilding layouts.

Visually, Pilgel leads with a full-viewport dark hero featuring a high-resolution iridescent 3D sculpture, large kinetic marquee typography repeating the word Innovate, and an annotated callout label reading AI Strategy. The color palette is near-black with vivid holographic accent imagery, creating strong contrast throughout. A sticky navigation bar includes a cart icon and hamburger menu, and the homepage features a 4.9/5 social proof indicator attributed to 200-plus clients alongside a structured services grid numbered 01 through 03.

Webflow-specific capabilities include a CMS for blog, project, and services collections, a background video section, a responsive slider, contact and inquiry forms, responsive navigation, web fonts, and a custom 404 page. The template is retina ready and fully responsive across breakpoints.

name: Yoouga Archived 20260519
long_description:
Yoouga is a Webflow template designed for yoga studios, wellness instructors, and mindfulness-focused fitness brands. It gives studio owners a complete, ready-to-launch web presence that communicates calm authority, builds community trust, and guides visitors from first impression through class discovery to direct contact or event sign-up.

The template spans 24 internal pages across three home layout variants, three service layout variants, three contact layout variants, individual class detail pages for styles including Beginner Yoga, Vinyasa Flow, Meditation and Mindfulness, Private Yoga Session, and Power Yoga, a blog with multiple article pages, a pricing page, an about page, a styleguide, changelog, licensing page, custom 404, and password page. CMS collections visibly power the class and blog content models, allowing instructors and studio managers to add or update content without touching the designer.

The visual direction pairs an oversized display typeface with dark, nature-grounded photography to create a grounded, editorial tone. The hero section leads with a full-viewport portrait and bold headline treatment alongside a social proof indicator displaying 250-plus happy clients. Section layouts use CSS Grid for structured content blocks, and a responsive slider handles gallery-style content presentation. Forms are present for contact and event registration touchpoints.

Yoouga is built on Webflow's CMS, enabling dynamic class listings and blog posts that scale without manual page duplication. Responsive navigation adapts across breakpoints, and the multi-layout page system lets buyers choose the home, service, and contact variant that best fits their brand without rebuilding from scratch. The included styleguide and changelog pages support ongoing customization and team handoff.

name: Verde Vita Archived 20260519
long_description:
Verde Vita is a multi-page Webflow template built for upscale restaurants, farm-to-table concepts, and nature-forward dining venues that need a polished web presence capable of handling reservations, catering inquiries, and event bookings. It gives restaurant owners and their designers a structured, ready-to-customise foundation that communicates brand story, cuisine philosophy, and operational details without requiring a build from scratch.

The template spans 13 internal pages including Home, About, Menu, Catering, Team, Blog, Contact, and a dedicated Reservation Events section with sub-pages for Wedding Receptions, Engagement Parties, and Birthday Celebrations. The homepage alone covers nine sections: a full-screen hero with a guest review badge, a brand story block, a Farm to Table feature, a drinks highlight, a private events call-to-action, and a testimonials strip. Navigation exposes all primary sections including a persistent Book a Table CTA.

Visually, Verde Vita pairs a warm earth-tone palette with serif editorial typography to evoke an organic, refined atmosphere consistent with its forest-dining concept. A full-screen background video anchors the hero, a responsive slider handles content carousels, and CSS Grid structures the menu and events layouts. The overall aesthetic is elegant and light without being sterile, leaning on lush photography and generous whitespace rather than heavy graphic elements.

On the Webflow capability side, the template is CMS-enabled, allowing dynamic management of menu items, blog posts, team profiles, and event types. Contact and reservation forms are built in, responsive navigation adapts across breakpoints, and the slider and CSS Grid components are natively Webflow. No ecommerce or lightbox functionality is included.

name: Damian Archived 20260519
long_description:
Damian is a full-featured Webflow portfolio template built for independent designers, developers, and creative professionals who need to present client work, articulate their services, and attract new business. It combines a personal brand identity with structured content areas that support everything from project case studies to service pricing and a blog, making it a self-contained professional presence rather than a simple single-page showcase.

The template spans 22 internal pages including a home page, seven individual project case study pages, a services page with two purchasable plan pages, an about page, three blog post pages, a contact page, a style guide, changelog, licenses page, and a custom 404. Section coverage on the home page includes a hero with live social proof statistics, a brand logo marquee, a portfolio grid, a core services breakdown, a client testimonials section, a service plans overview, a blog articles section, an FAQ section, and a closing call-to-action.

Visually, Damian uses a dark, high-contrast aesthetic anchored by a deep warm background, oversized display typography that bleeds to the viewport edge, and a restrained white and off-white text palette. The hero layout positions a full-bleed portrait photograph behind headline copy and a service listing overlay, creating a layered depth effect. Social proof credentials including a 4.9/5 star rating and 100-plus businesses served are surfaced directly in the hero without requiring scroll.

The template is built on Webflow CMS, enabling dynamic management of projects, blog posts, and services collections without touching the Designer for routine content updates. A contact form is included for lead capture. The layout uses CSS Grid for structured multi-column arrangements, web fonts deliver the oversized display type, and the navigation is fully responsive with a cart element visible in the nav bar. A style guide and changelog page are included to support ongoing customization.

name: Mindiex Archived 20260519
long_description:
Mindiex is a multi-page Webflow template designed for AI agencies, tech startups, and digital product studios that need a credible, conversion-focused web presence. It gives teams a structured foundation to present services, showcase projects, publish thought-leadership content, and move visitors toward a purchase or inquiry without starting from scratch.

The template spans 28 internal pages covering core marketing sections including home, about, services, projects, team, blog, pricing, and contact, alongside utility pages such as a style guide, changelog, licences, password-protected page, and custom 404. Detail pages exist for individual services, projects, blog posts, pricing tiers, and product categories, giving the CMS a fully realized content model that scales as the business grows. Ecommerce-ready checkout, PayPal checkout, and order confirmation pages are also included.

The visual direction is built around a deep black and dark crimson palette with an abstract 3D orb hero element, flowing wave textures, and a dashed orbital ring motif that reinforces the neural and intelligence theme. Typography is wide-tracked and editorial, pairing large display headings such as Neural vision and Intelligence built for value with restrained body copy. A cart icon and grid-style menu toggle in the navigation reflect the ecommerce and multi-section structure visible throughout the layout.

Mindiex is built with Webflow CMS to manage blog posts, projects, services, and team members dynamically. Checkout and order confirmation pages indicate ecommerce infrastructure is wired in. A contact form supports lead capture, background video adds cinematic depth to the hero, responsive navigation adapts across breakpoints, and web fonts and retina-ready assets maintain visual fidelity at all screen sizes.

name: PowerGrid Archived 20260519
long_description:
PowerGrid is a multi-page Webflow template designed for renewable energy businesses, sustainability consultancies, and clean-tech companies that need a professional web presence to communicate impact, showcase projects, and generate leads. It suits organisations offering solar, wind, hydropower, EV charging, and smart energy solutions to both commercial and residential audiences.

The template includes 20 internal pages covering core business needs: Home, About, Projects, Services, Blog, Contact, Style Guide, and utility pages such as 404 and a password-protected page. CMS collections power the Projects and Blog sections, with individual detail pages visible for solar installation, wind energy, energy storage, and blog articles. The Services section branches into dedicated pages for EV charging, green building, maintenance support, smart energy systems, and hydropower.

The visual direction pairs a dark, nature-forward photographic aesthetic — wind turbines over lush green mountains — with a high-contrast lime-green accent color used on buttons and highlights. Typography mixes bold display weights with an italic serif for editorial contrast. The hero section features a full-bleed background video, oversized background wordmark, and a frosted-glass card layout. A metrics section uses large counter-style numerals to communicate scale across solar panels installed, clean energy generated, customer count, and energy storage systems.

PowerGrid is built on Webflow CMS for managing project case studies and blog posts without code. It includes a contact form, media lightbox, CSS Grid layouts, responsive navigation with a Pages dropdown, a custom 404 page, and background video support. The template is fully responsive and retina ready across all breakpoints.

name: Zhallar Archived 20260519
long_description:
Zhallar is a premium editorial Webflow template designed specifically for independent wealth managers, fiduciary advisors, and personal finance consultants who need to communicate expertise, trust, and long-term thinking to high-net-worth clients. Its core job is to position the advisor as a thoughtful, values-driven partner rather than a product-pushing broker, using editorial hierarchy and restrained visual language to do the heavy lifting.

The template spans seven pages: About, Services, Insights, Contact, two individual blog post pages, and a Utilities page. Key sections include a hero with social proof, a philosophy pillar block covering values-driven investing, radical simplicity, and transparency, a services section structured around stages of wealth, a partnership standards section, a client testimonials block, and a News and Insights feed. The Insights section is backed by a CMS collection, with individual post pages already templated and populated with long-form financial editorial content.

Visually, Zhallar uses a warm off-white base contrasted with a dark black navigation bar, heavy editorial serif-style headings, and UI card overlays simulating net worth tracker widgets and performance dashboards. This creates a fintech-informed aesthetic without being cold or data-heavy. A responsive slider handles content rotation, and CSS Grid structures the multi-column service and philosophy layouts with consistent spacing and typographic discipline.

Customization is supported through Webflow CMS for the Insights blog, a responsive navigation with a distinct call-to-action button, a responsive slider, CSS Grid layouts, web fonts, and full retina-ready asset handling. The template is multi-page and built for straightforward rebinding to a real advisor brand with minimal structural changes required.
